clips.title: The story
paras: Following a desperate plea from the dying dryad Anilia, an adventurer is tasked with recovering a sacred relic stolen by the vile satyr Geltharis. Reclaiming the Branch of Cenarius means confronting the demon-sworn corrupters lurking in eastern Ashenvale and returning the treasured bough to the dryad Illiyana.

Sent into the corrupted folds of eastern Ashenvale to search for missing dryads, Alliance travelers stumble upon Anilia clinging to the very edge of life. With her final breaths, the wounded daughter of Cenarius gestures toward the satyr ruins to the north. Gasping out the name of the satyr who has taken it—Geltharis—she begs with her fading strength for the recovery of the Branch of Cenarius before succumbing to her wounds.

The thief, Geltharis, is a vile satyr nested within the ancient elven ruins of Xavian. To the satyr, ancient relics tied to the demigod Cenarius are prized trophies ripe for defilement and demonic mockery. Defeating Geltharis and tearing the branch from his claws is not merely an act of justice for Anilia, but a defense against the spreading taint that the Burning Legion's ancient servants inflict upon Ashenvale's sacred flora.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. "He has taken it... Geltharis..." You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found them? What did Anilia say? Where is she?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Anilia died? No... That can't be! It was just yesterday that we were running and playing together in the woods.
I guess those days are over...
